```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# overview
- extract target species cluster effects (fixed effect) from each bycatch species model and combined into a cluster × species matrix
- exploerd a PCA initially but because there were only four cluster categories, the heatmap was more informative

```{r}
# Load fitted models
model_files <- list.files("models/", pattern = "best_model\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
response_names <- gsub("_best_model\\.rds$", "", basename(model_files))
models <- setNames(lapply(model_files, readRDS), response_names)

# Extract target cluster coefficients
extract_cluster <- function(model){
  cf <- coef(model)
  vals <- cf[grep("^target_cluster", names(cf))]
  names(vals) <- gsub("^target_cluster", "", names(vals))
  c("Mixed" = 0,  # reference level
    vals
  )
}
cluster_effects <- lapply(models, extract_cluster)

# Cluster × response matrix
cluster_matrix <- sapply(cluster_effects, identity)

round(cluster_matrix, 2)

# Convert matrix to long format for plotting
heat_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(t(cluster_matrix)))
names(heat_df) <- c("Response", "Cluster", "Coefficient")
```

## heatmap of fitted coefficients
```{r}
# Heatmap of fitted coefficients
ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = Cluster, y = Response, fill = Coefficient)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Coefficient, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027",  midpoint = 0, name = "Coefficient") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )
```
